title: UAAP: Bulldogs pull away late, clinch Final Four berth at Red Warriors’ expense
summary: National University pulled away late against University of the East, 91-74, to clinch a Final Four berth in UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball on Saturday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
